segments.title: Chương 52: Táo khó tặng
segments.content:
Wednesday was Christmas Eve.

The night before, discussion had already begun in Dorm 205 of the girls' building.

Xiong Xiaoying from Bed 3 was the first to bring up the topic. "Did you know? You're supposed to give apples on Christmas Eve to wish people peace and safety."

"Who did you hear that from?" asked the chubby girl Zhu Yun from Bed 4, munching on potato chips.

Xiong Xiaoying said, "All the seniors say so. It's been a trend overseas for years."

Tao Xue said, "But the English words for 'apple' and 'peace' don't sound alike, do they?"

"It's not because of the pun that foreigners give apples," Xiong Xiaoying said with an air of authority. "In the West, apples symbolize health, longevity, and rebirth. I think it originally had something to do with religion, and the tradition was just passed down through generations."

"Really?" Tao Xue was starting to believe it.

Information was not readily available in this era. With limited channels to get news, all sorts of urban legends spread by word of mouth.

And they were the same all across the country.

For instance, that Dave Wang's voice was ruined by poison, that Timi Zhuo died in a car crash, that Wong Ka Kui was intentionally murdered by the Japanese...

"Tiantian, what do people give on Christmas Eve where you're from?" Zhu Yun asked Yu Tian in Bed 2.

Yu Tian was from the neighboring "City of Liquor," where Wuliangye was produced.

Her accent was vastly different from Longdu's. She was occasionally teased for it and gradually grew quiet.

"I don't know. I think they give apples too," Yu Tian guessed.

Xiong Xiaoying said bravely, "I want to give Wang Haochuan an apple. Do you think he'll accept it?"

"Ooooh~~~"

Tao Xue and Zhu Yun drew out the sound in unison.

"What's with the 'ooooh'? I just like him," Xiong Xiaoying was one to love and hate openly. "Wang Haochuan is handsome, good at basketball, and his grades are pretty good too."

Zhu Yun joked, "Go for it. Be his sugar mommy!"

"What 'sugar mommy'? That sounds so awful," Xiong Xiaoying said, annoyed.

Of course, those who lived in a four-person dorm room all came from wealthy families.

But that Wang Haochuan was a boy from the countryside.

Xiong Xiaoying continued, "I'll give him an apple tomorrow. If he accepts it, I'll give him a scarf for New Year's. And it'll be a scarf I knitted myself!"

"You know how to knit?" Tao Xue asked, surprised.

Xiong Xiaoying said smugly, "I've known since I was a kid. My mom taught me."

Tao Xue wondered to herself: Should I learn how to knit too?

On impulse, she took out her phone and texted Bian Guanyue: "Senior Sister, tomorrow is Christmas Eve. What are you getting my grandnephew?"

Bian Guanyue was at home working on practice papers. She was a little stunned when she received the text.

She hadn't paid any attention to it and had no idea Christmas Eve and Christmas were so close.

After thinking for a moment, Bian Guanyue replied, "I'm not planning to give a gift. Are you?"

"I'm his elder. He should be the one giving me a gift, okay," Tao Xue sent the text, then quickly added another. "I'm not giving him anything."

The text exchange ended there.

Bian Guanyue was no longer in the mood to do her practice problems. She took out the pebble again and toyed with it.

After a long while, Bian Guanyue picked up her phone again and texted an old friend in Rongcheng: "What's a good gift for Christmas Eve?"

"For a guy or a girl?"

"A guy."

"No way! You're actually giving a gift to a guy! Oh my god, oh my god, oh my god..."

"What's with your reaction?"

"We were classmates from middle school through high school. In all the years I've known you, you've never given a gift to a boy. You're not dating, are you?"

"Just a normal friend."

"Sprinkling pepper on a grave—who are you trying to fool, ghost whisperer?"

"Fine, don't tell me then."

"Just give him an apple or something. See what he gets you for Christmas."

"Thanks. Talk later."

"Friends are nothing when you've got a man."

Bian Guanyue put down her phone and stared blankly, slumped over her desk.

She wanted to buy an apple tomorrow, but she had already told Tao Xue she wasn't giving any gifts.

It would be so embarrassing if Tao Xue found out.

Sigh, forget it!

I'll just buy small potatoes for Chen Guiliang instead.

The next day, at noon.

Tao Xue, an apple in her pocket, pretended to be strolling around casually and passed by the Senior 3 Class 11.

She stood at the door and peeked in, seeing Chen Guiliang studying. Bian Guanyue hadn't arrived at school yet.

Hesitating as she walked, Tao Xue ultimately didn't go in.

After walking from the front door all the way to the back, Tao Xue took the apple out of her pocket, took a fierce bite, and sauntered back to her own classroom as if nothing had happened.

"Hey, did you give out your apple?" Tao Xue asked.

Xiong Xiaoying was quite nervous. "Not yet. What if Wang Haochuan doesn't accept it?"

Tao Xue feigned nonchalance. "If he doesn't, he doesn't. Just means he's blind. What are you afraid of?"

"Forget it, I'll just eat it myself." Xiong Xiaoying backed out at the last minute.

Although her family was rich, she wasn't exceptionally pretty, and Wang Haochuan was so outstanding.

She felt insecure.

Tao Xue touched the apple with a bite taken out of it in her pocket and said, vexed at her friend's lack of courage, "Don't be afraid. Be brave and take the first step. I support you!"

Xiong Xiaoying shook her head repeatedly. "Forget it, forget it."

"Then knit him a scarf and give it to him. I'll help you knit," Tao Xue suggested.

Xiong Xiaoying asked, "You know how to knit too?"

Tao Xue said, "I don't, but you can teach me."

Xiong Xiaoying looked suspicious. "You're not planning to learn how to knit a sweater, are you?"

"Of course not!" Tao Xue flatly denied.

The class president, Li Rui, was also a day student. He came to school every day at noon and would always check the mailboxes on his way.

Against the wall was a whole row of dark green mail cubbies, further divided into individual mailboxes for each class.

Li Rui took out his key and opened it. Finding three letters inside, he grabbed them and headed to the classroom.

"Wang Lei, your letter." Li Rui took out one and placed it on Wang Lei's desk.

"Thanks, Class President."

Wang Lei was overjoyed to receive the letter. It was from his pen pal, with whom he had been corresponding for a year. He had even made a pact with his pen pal to get into a university in the same city.

The recipient of another letter hadn't arrived in the classroom yet.

Li Rui walked to the front row of Chen Guiliang's desk, plopped down, and said, "Great Hero Chen, your letter."

"Thanks."

Chen Guiliang glanced at the envelope. The sender was the New Concept Composition Competition Committee.

An invitation to the semi-finals!

Li Rui was quite curious and urged, "Open it and let's see. I've never seen what an invitation to the New Concept Competition looks like."

"An invitation?"

His deskmate, Qin Shanshan, was even more thrilled than Chen Guiliang. "Great Hero Chen, you passed the preliminary round?"

Chen Guiliang opened the letter, and Li Rui and Qin Shanshan immediately leaned in.

Qin Shanshan read aloud, "Dear contestant Chen Guiliang: Congratulations on passing the preliminary selection and advancing to the semi-finals of the 6th National New Concept Composition Competition. The semi-finals will be held..."

Before she could finish reading the invitation, several classmates around them had already been drawn over.

"Great Hero Chen, you're awesome!" Guan Zhiqiang exclaimed in admiration.

Chen Guiliang thought to himself: You're pretty awesome yourself. In another month, you'll manage to pass the art exam for a certain academy of fine arts without anyone knowing.

Guan Zhiqiang's family wasn't truly powerful or well-connected, just a private business owner in a small city.

In those days, as long as you found the right connections, tens of thousands of yuan could get it done.

It was insane.

Next year, there would even be a bizarre case exposed where a head teacher from some school took dozens of second-year high school students to participate illegally in the official college entrance exams. It was just so the students could experience it in advance... who knows how they managed it.

"Let me see, let me see!"

Another classmate ran over.

Xu Haibo, as if he were the one competing, yelled at the top of his lungs, "Great Hero Chen passed the New Concept preliminaries!"

None of them had ever seen a New Concept semi-final invitation. In no time, everyone had come over to see what the commotion was about, passing it around until it ended up in some unknown person's hands.

If it had been a normal high school student, they probably would have started to panic by now, afraid the invitation would be damaged or lost.

Chen Guiliang simply smiled as he answered everyone's questions.

As for the invitation, it wouldn't matter if it got lost. He could just show up empty-handed to compete.

Even if you lost your university admission letter, you could still show up empty-handed to register.

What was the big deal?

"Great Hero Chen, if you get first prize, does that mean you can get direct admission to Tsinghua or Peking University?"

"They stopped doing that after the third competition. The universities changed their minds at the last minute, and a lot of people got screwed over. Didn't Guo Xiaosi have to repeat a year?"

"Then what's the deal with direct admission now?"

"It's similar to independent recruitment. It depends on the specific arrangements of the university."

"Then you'll definitely get your admission score lowered."

"I hope so."

"If you become famous in the future, don't forget to give me an autograph."

"Of course."

"Haha, I want an autograph now. When you're famous, I'll sell it to your fans."

"..."

Many students returned to their seats after looking at the semi-final invitation.

But about a dozen or so remained, gathered around Chen Guiliang, laughing and joking.

Xie Yang examined the invitation carefully and reminded him, "You need to bring your ID card and a copy. Have you gotten an ID card yet?"

"I got it last summer vacation," Chen Guiliang said.

Xie Yang then shouted, "Damn, New Concept is so stingy, they don't even arrange for accommodation. You have to pay for your own hotel when you go to compete!"

"It's business, no shame in it," Chen Guiliang said with a smile.

During the competition, although food and lodging were self-catered, the staff would recommend hotels and earn a little referral fee on the side.

Sometimes it got very unpleasant; hotels might suddenly raise their prices!

Bian Guanyue walked into the classroom, holding a "candied apple," an apple version of candied hawthorns.

She hadn't bought it. Zheng Feng had given it to her, forcing it on her even after she had refused.

"Wu Meng, this is for you." Bian Guanyue handed the candied apple to Wu Meng.

Zheng Feng: "..."

"Thanks." Wu Meng took it with a smile.

Bian Guanyue looked toward the back. "Why is Chen Guiliang surrounded by people?"

Wu Meng explained, "The invitation for the New Concept semi-finals arrived. They're all over there checking it out."

Zheng Feng's heart skipped a beat when he heard that. Could Chen Guiliang become a writer?

Pretending to go chat with a friend, he walked to the edge of the crowd and tiptoed to peek, then returned to his seat, dejected.

This is so hard.

What if I can't compete with him?

A little while later, Li Jun returned to the classroom holding a basketball, still wearing a thin jersey despite the winter cold.

He put the basketball down, wiped the sweat from his forehead, and asked, "What's going on over there?"

Guan Zhiqiang said, "Great Hero Chen is going to the New Concept semi-finals."

"Tch!"

Li Jun pursed his lips and said sarcastically, "Getting into the semi-finals doesn't mean he'll win an award. Treating him like a celebrity already, you guys are so easily impressed and ignorant!"

"Heh heh."

Guan Zhiqiang chuckled foolishly and went back to reading his novel, though his hidden lips were mouthing "idiot."

With his personality, he was already finding Li Jun unbearable and had been tempted to just start a fight several times.

"Bang, bang, bang!"

The politics teacher, Gao Zhan, rapped the lectern with a blackboard eraser and scolded, "Class is about to start, what are you all still gathered around for?"

The students hurried back to their seats.

Xu Haibo said, "Teacher Gao, Chen Guiliang passed the New Concept preliminaries."

"Oh?"

Gao Zhan's interest was piqued. "Let me see."

Chen Guiliang walked up to the lectern.

Gao Zhan read the semi-final invitation carefully, nodding repeatedly in approval. Then he admonished, "When you go to the Magic City, compete well. No more getting into fights. Because you violated discipline, your Teacher Liu has pleaded on your behalf with the principal and the dean of students I don't know how many times. I was even with her getting scolded on two of those occasions."

"Thank you, Teacher Liu, and thank you, Teacher Gao," Chen Guiliang said.

This politics teacher, who liked to praise Europe and America and complain about the quality of his countrymen, stood up after reading the invitation and walked to the classroom door. "Come here a minute."

Chen Guiliang immediately followed.

Out in the hallway, Gao Zhan asked in a low voice, "The invitation says you have to cover your own food and lodging. Hotels and restaurants in the Magic City are very expensive. Are you okay financially?"

"No problem," Chen Guiliang said.

"If you're short on money, just say so. I know a little about your family's situation." Gao Zhan was already reaching for his wallet.

Opening his wallet, Gao Zhan's expression turned a little awkward. "Ahem... I don't have enough cash on me. After school, stay in the classroom and don't leave. I'll drive you to the bank to withdraw some money."

He didn't actually have much private spending money; he'd have to talk to his wife, Liu Shuying, first.

The bank card was in his wife's possession.

Chen Guiliang said, "Really, there's no need. My parents have already paid off their debts. They took on a small construction project a while ago. But thank you anyway, Teacher Gao."

Chen Guiliang bowed formally.

"Alright, but if you're short on money, just tell me. Don't feel embarrassed." Gao Zhan put his thin wallet back in his pocket.
